deepResearchDelta.status: canonical research overlay; no fundamental-score changes
deepResearchDelta.aiFunding: Treat Project Jupiter/Hyperion/SB Energy/Holtec as evidence of capital selectivity and higher cost of capital, not proof that AI demand has collapsed. Nscale remains the key counterexample.
deepResearchDelta.guarantees: Track residual-value/credit guarantees and single-tenant concentration as explicit project-quality risks.
deepResearchDelta.agentic: Separate agent/inference beneficiaries from potentially disrupted wealth/insurance/subscription intermediaries; do not attribute bank weakness to AI without rate-controlled relative performance.
deepResearchDelta.breadth: Use multiple breadth horizons rather than one score: advance/decline, new highs-lows, % above 20/50DMA and sector relative strength.
deepResearchDelta.rates: Decompose rates into energy-inflation, demand/real-rate and issuance/supply channels.
deepResearchDelta.energy: Keep crude risk-premium relief separate from ULSD/cracks/freight/refinery-product stress.
